verdict.rationale: Buzz supports autonomous background agents via buzz-agent runtime, buzz-acp harness that listens for @mentions and prompts agents headlessly, remote agent deployment on Kubernetes substrates with no ongoing control channel, workflow triggers/YAML automations, and a benchmark suite validating autonomous behavior — all documented first-party with a live repo probe confirming AGENTS.md and skill mirroring. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation that automations reliably run unattended in production (community commentary is skeptical but not a concrete failure report), and more detail on scheduling/triggering conditions beyond @mentions and workflow triggers.
